title: 37487 跟进：引用定位在同名标题与空段落两个边角的处理
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbeF2saT6wUBV4E9uc

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37487. The source is seat 5's REWORK 7193228908 on PR #37539, which asks for a card carrying N6 and N7 of scope note 7190147175 before `Fixes #37487` closes the only card that holds them. The owning area files it under the source card, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p3 · reach: a chip whose cited heading shares its title with an unlisted heading, and an empty-reading section · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：点引用打开记录时，有两个小边角：同名标题的计数检查可能挑错段落；内容为空时要等 4 秒才定位。补上这两处。
- 谁受益：使用 AI 引用的用户。
- 不做会怎样：极少数情况下定位到同名的另一段，或空段落定位慢。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
From scope note 7190147175 on the record-section locator (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordSectionAnchor.ts`, PR #37485):
- N6: the count check does not exclude the case of one unlisted same-titled heading plus one listed-but-undrawn heading, so the locator can pick the wrong one. Make the check tell them apart.
- N7: when the reading is empty, the field opens only after the 4 s settle. Open it as soon as the empty reading is known.

## Acceptance
- A test per case, each with a control.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
